headline: Six Fronts Boil as Ownership Flips Surge
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the churn on the map has sharpened across a half‑dozen sectors. Weathered Expanse remains the hottest flashpoint, recording 35 ownership changes in the past 24 hours and a fresh surge of 12 015 Colonial and 12 198 Warden casualties, with both sides’ enlistments accelerating. Mooring County matches that tempo, also logging 35 flips and a 24‑hour toll of 10 714 Colonial and 9 796 Warden dead while fresh troops pour in. Stonecradle continues to bleed, adding 17 flips centred on World’s End, The Reach and Buckler Sound, pushing its totals to 61 577 Colonial and 78 696 Warden casualties. Stlican Shelf registers 11 flips around Fort Hoarfrost and The Pale House, now at 59 371 Colonial and 66 569 Warden losses. Farranac Coast, previously steady, shows seven new flips and a 24‑hour cost of 2 110 Colonial and 3 099 Warden. Palantine Berm erupts with three flips, the first notable activity there this war, driving its toll to 1 833 Colonial and 2 389 Warden. Northern Warden‑held rear areas and most Colonial‑only regions remain quiet, with no ownership changes reported.
